WITH p AS (SELECT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - 29) AS d0, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS d1),
c AS (SELECT id, name FROM companies WHERE slug IN ('castelo-da-diversao', 'megamegic', 'planeta-divertido')),
l AS (SELECT l.company_id, l.status, upper(trim(coalesce(l.unit, ''))) AS ch FROM campaign_leads l, p WHERE l.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM c) AND (l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 AND l.status NOT IN ('transferido', 'trabalhe_conosco', 'fornecedor', 'outros')),
e AS (SELECT e.company_id, e.lead_id, e.total_value FROM company_events e, p WHERE e.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM c) AND e.status <> 'cancelado' AND coalesce(e.data_fechamento_venda::date, (e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1),
v AS (SELECT v.company_id, v.status_visita, v.data_visita::date AS d, upper(trim(coalesce(v.unit, ''))) AS ch FROM lead_visits v, p WHERE v.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM c) AND v.data_visita::date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1)
SELECT c.name AS empresa,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE l.company_id = c.id) AS leads,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.status = 'fechado') AS fechados_conta_antiga,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM e WHERE e.company_id = c.id) AS festas_novo,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM e WHERE e.company_id = c.id AND coalesce(e.total_value, 0) > 0) AS festas_com_valor,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.status_visita = 'realizada') AS realizadas,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.status_visita = 'nao_compareceu') AS faltou,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM v, p WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.status_visita IN ('agendada', 'confirmada', 'remarcada') AND v.d < p.d1) AS sem_resposta,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM v, p WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.status_visita IN ('agendada', 'confirmada', 'remarcada') AND v.d >= p.d1) AS hoje_ou_depois,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.status_visita = 'cancelada') AS canceladas,
 (SELECT string_agg(x.ch || ' ' || x.nl || 'L/' || x.nv || 'V/' || x.nf || 'F', ' | ' ORDER BY x.nl DESC) FROM (SELECT u.ch, sum(u.nl) AS nl, sum(u.nv) AS nv, sum(u.nf) AS nf FROM (SELECT l.ch, 1 AS nl, 0 AS nv, 0 AS nf FROM l WHERE l.company_id = c.id UNION ALL SELECT v.ch, 0, 1, 0 FROM v WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.status_visita = 'realizada' UNION ALL SELECT upper(trim(coalesce(cl.unit, ''))), 0, 0, 1 FROM e LEFT JOIN campaign_leads cl ON cl.id = e.lead_id WHERE e.company_id = c.id) u GROUP BY u.ch) x) AS por_canal,
 (SELECT s.unit FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.company_id = c.id) AS canal_ia
FROM c ORDER BY c.name
